subject: Exact-phrase research for ASK Coin, actual capital, SBIC/ChatGPT SBIC and Camilla/Kamilah Stevenson identity attribution

capture.note: Run start is context only. The web retrieval tool did not expose exact per-request timestamps or original HTTP response bytes. Issuer publication dates and SEC filing/effectiveness dates are retained separately.

strongest_candidate.issuer_claim: Native token of the Permission ecosystem
strongest_candidate.official_website_use: Family-friendly crypto rewards for positive behavior; users can earn ASK and redeem it for gift cards through the rewards partner Tremendous.
official_documentation_utility: Rewards and incentives for users in Permission-powered experiences.
Agent-to-agent value exchange within the Permission Protocol.
Governance and staking are described as future capabilities in the token documentation.
strongest_candidate.bridging_and_liquidity: Official docs state ASK is live on Stargate.
distinction: This ASK is the Permission ecosystem token, not XRP.
The issuer's documented active networks are Base and Polygon through LayerZero OFT; no XRPL-native ASK deployment was established in this research.
The official token documentation does not identify Ripple, XRP, SBI, Coinbase or Circle as ASK counterparties.

A separate Permission issuer blog dated 2026-09-22 documents Coinbase Embedded Wallet infrastructure for Permission's ASK wallet. This is a wallet-provider relationship, not evidence that Coinbase is an ASK token issuer/market maker or an XRP counterparty.
caveats: The issuer's whitepaper is self-published and contains forward-looking product, adoption and token-utility claims.
Future governance/staking is not represented as a currently completed capability.
The exact phrase ASK Coin may match other unrelated assets or projects; Permission ASK is the strongest verified candidate, not an exhaustive universe.

wallet_infrastructure_relationship.issuer_statement: Permission says its wallet moved to Coinbase's platform; Coinbase secures the private key on users' behalf, while the user's Permission login authorizes transactions.
wallet_infrastructure_relationship.key_control: Permission says it no longer holds wallet keys; Coinbase secures them in its systems and supports key export.
wallet_infrastructure_relationship.classification: Direct wallet-infrastructure relationship between Permission and Coinbase; not an ASK token issuance, market-making or XRP relationship.

third_party_listing.role: Secondary listing corroboration only; official Permission docs provide full Base and Polygon addresses.

exact_phrase_search.usage_summary: The article says actual capital inflows must be confirmed when assessing Evernorth's XRP treasury and Nasdaq listing.

evernorth_cantor_equity_line.facility_type: Committed equity line of credit (ELOC), not a funded loan or cash balance.
evernorth_cantor_equity_line.purchase_price_mechanism: 97% of the applicable volume-weighted average price, subject to agreement terms and conditions.
evernorth_cantor_equity_line.issuer_control: Evernorth may direct purchases/sales from time to time at its option; the timing and amount depend on its decisions and market conditions.
evernorth_cantor_equity_line.fee_timing: Payable by Evernorth to Cantor within five business days following the Upfront Determination Date.
interpretation: The approximately $80.7M is a maximum illustrative gross-proceeds estimate using the October 22 XRPN closing price and the full share amount, not cash already received.
The company must elect to issue/sell shares; the facility does not establish that any shares have been sold or any proceeds received.
The October 30 registration effectiveness permits the registered resale process to proceed subject to the agreement, but is not evidence of a drawdown or sale.
The $521,893.50 commitment fee is a fee payable by Evernorth, not capital raised.
Even if proceeds are later received, their use must be traced separately before classifying them as XRP purchases.

prior_primary_capital_records.reference: The existing XRP research archive separately records Evernorth's closing cash XRP purchases, in-kind XRP contributions, share subscriptions, debt/credit facilities and related-party borrowings.
prior_primary_capital_records.rule: Do not combine cash purchases, in-kind contributions, potential ELOC proceeds, undrawn facilities, notes, debt or gross proceeds into one 'actual capital invested in XRP' number.

sbic_chatgpt.limitation: Search-engine non-return is not proof that the phrase does not exist in unindexed, private, deleted or differently punctuated sources.
preserved_disambiguations: Japanese SBIC East, SBIC Central and SBIC West are separate regional entities.
SBI Holdings is a separate corporate group and must not be conflated with the regional SBIC companies.
In ChatGPT academic-benchmark literature, SBIC refers to the Social Bias Inference Corpus, not SBI Holdings or the Japanese regional companies.

public_media_corroboration.episode_title: Crypto Panics! with Dr. Kamilah Stevenson
public_media_corroboration.transcript_note: The episode title identifies the guest as Dr. Kamilah Stevenson. The autogenerated transcript has the host call the guest Camila/Camilla and says viewers have seen her on YouTube discussing XRP.
public_media_corroboration.source_caveat: iHeart states that transcripts are automatically generated and may not be completely accurate.

camilla_kamilah_stevenson.classification: The iHeart item is a podcast episode, not a YouTube video. It corroborates the public creator attribution but does not independently establish legal identity or ownership of every similarly named account.

claims_supported: Permission's own description of ASK as a family-friendly reward token and gift-card redemption.
ASK utility, 100B fixed supply, LayerZero OFT, Base and Polygon contract addresses, Stargate integration, future governance/staking.
Issuer's token and platform design, marketplace, supply and forward-looking plans.
Secondary Permission Coin/ASK listing and truncated contract display.
ELOC agreement with Cantor, up to 5,218,935 newly issued shares and issuer discretion over timing/amount.

source_registry.publisher: iHeart / The XRP Podcast with Paul Barron
claims_supported: Public guest attribution to Dr. Kamilah Stevenson and transcript's Camila/Camilla spelling variants; not legal identity proof.
Permission moved its ASK wallet to Coinbase Embedded Wallet.
Coinbase secures private keys on users' behalf; Permission says it no longer holds wallet keys.

source_registry.normalized_evidence: Permission announced on 2026-09-22 that its ASK wallet moved to Coinbase's Embedded Wallet platform. Permission says Coinbase secures private keys on users' behalf, transactions are authorized through the user's Permission login, Permission no longer holds wallet keys, and user email, account identifier and wallet information are shared with Coinbase to operate the wallet. Key export is supported.
source_registry.exact_quote: We've partnered with Coinbase to bring best-in-class wallet technology to our community.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The exact phrase ASK Coin refers to Permission's ASK token.
supporting_evidence: Permission's official site and token documentation identify ASK as its native token.
Official docs specify Base and Polygon contracts and LayerZero OFT deployment.
disconfirming_evidence: ASK is a short ticker/name used by other unrelated projects; the exact phrase alone is ambiguous.
No direct XRP/XRPL relationship is established.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The Evernorth Cantor ELOC represents up to $80.7M of actual capital already available for XRP purchases.
supporting_evidence: The SEC filing documents a committed equity facility and a maximum illustrative gross-proceeds estimate.
disconfirming_evidence: Evernorth controls whether and when shares are issued; no actual share sale or cash drawdown is verified.
The $80.7M estimate depends on the October 22 stock price and full share utilization.
The commitment fee is payable by Evernorth; the facility is not cash already received.
Proceeds use must be separately verified before attributing any XRP purchases.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The iHeart guest and the public YouTube creator attributed as Kamilah/Camilla Stevenson are the same public creator.
supporting_evidence: The iHeart episode identifies Dr. Kamilah Stevenson; the host transcript calls her Camila/Camilla and says she is known on YouTube for XRP content.
disconfirming_evidence: Legal identity and ownership of external social handles are not independently verified.
The podcast is not itself a YouTube video.

model_ineligibility_reasons: These are identity, token-entity and corporate-capital classification findings, not synchronized market features.
The ELOC filing establishes a facility and potential proceeds, not actual share sales, cash receipts or XRP purchases.
The ASK candidate is identified from issuer documentation, but no XRP relationship is established.
The SBIC exact-phrase search was not exhaustive.
The Kamilah transcript is autogenerated and does not establish legal identity.
